entry_sequence: Root reviews all three exact completed capacity measurements and admits only these three structural members with explicit generation/FIT identities.
Record final readiness/structural-only analysis recipes and generation/FIT/structural-read ledger entries before contact.

Prepare each own supply once from the finalized policy/roster using existing prepare-supply; bind and re-pin only with the existing supported utility after source and allowed-stage identity are fixed. Preserve every prior prepared envelope.
Freeze a separate clean worker and verify every own supply, first-phase material seed, actual policy role bytes, entry modes, source compatibility with capacity, registration and readiness.

Root performs an ordinary completed-control transition only after prior jobs ended normally, lease absent and STOP absent, preserving old queue/status/driver logs. This draft does not permit failure reconciliation.
Run the existing Windows-owned shared batch driver in engineering worker-only mode, with one generation worker, no official score, 12.5 GiB startup and 8 GiB running guards.

Read structural role/control handoffs, actual request FIT and native Omni custody only; preserve OPENED attempt plus completed manifest/prepared score specifications as the intentional unscored lifecycle.
Stop on any defect; no retry, reseal, scoring, quality read, proposal repair or automatic 8x20 dispatch.
